instruction: Insert an 'IMPORTANT' note on the slide.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding a slide note with specific text 'IMPORTANT'. The evaluator checks if the note text matches exactly. Custom getter extracts note text from the slide, custom metric compares it against expected text.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts slide note text using python-pptx library from the specified slide index
Metric correctly compares extracted note text with expected value using exact string match (case-sensitive)
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the exact requirement (note text = 'IMPORTANT')
Correct parameter handling: metric directly accesses expected.get('note_text') from rules dict (not expected.get('rules'))
Postconfig properly saves file with Ctrl+S before extraction to ensure note changes are persisted
Data flow is correct: getter extracts right state → metric compares right aspect → expected value matches instruction
Edge cases handled: getter returns empty string if no note exists, enabling proper comparison
